description: MicroGridsPy, published by Politecnico di Milano, SESAM, optimizes microgrid technology sizing and dispatch, including isolated and grid-connected cases. Coverage: The current README describes version 2.1, minute-resolution optimization, multiyear expansion and rural-load archetypes for sub-Saharan Africa; these are selectable functions, not a universal calibrated dataset. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: EUPL-1.2, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README directs macOS users to version 2.0. Gurobi and GLPK are listed as confirmed solvers, but this review did not execute either. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
